empresa.title: Set up your company
empresa.description: Add the name, tax ID and fiscal address. This data will appear on all your invoices.
empresa.detail: Go to Settings → Company and fill in your business details. It only needs to be done once.

tips.0: The tax ID (NIF/CIF) is mandatory to issue valid invoices in Spain.
tips.1: You can add your logo later from the same panel.

apiKeys.title: Set up your AI key
apiKeys.description: The agents use your own AI key (BYOK model). Without a key, the AI does not work.
apiKeys.detail: Go to Settings → API Keys, choose a provider (Anthropic recommended; also OpenAI or Groq), paste your key and activate it. It is stored encrypted and you can change it whenever you want.

tips.0: Create the key on the provider's website (e.g. console.anthropic.com); you only pay for your usage.
tips.1: Claude Code only works if you have the Claude CLI installed (advanced/dev use).

clientes.title: Register your first customers
clientes.description: Build your contacts directory: customers, suppliers or leads. The AI will use them when generating invoices.
clientes.detail: In Contacts you can import them manually or let the AI detect them automatically when scanning received invoices.

tips.0: The customer's tax ID is validated automatically when issuing an invoice.
tips.1: Filter by type: Customer, Supplier, Lead or Company.

catalogo.title: Create your products and services catalog
catalogo.description: Define the items or services you sell with their price and VAT. This way the AI can fill in invoices in seconds.
catalogo.detail: The catalog centralizes prices and VAT rates. When you ask the AI 'invoice Tech SL for 3 hours of consulting', it searches the catalog and completes the invoice automatically.

tips.0: Assign SKUs/references if you have items with a code.
tips.1: The default VAT is 21% — change it to 0% for exports.

factura.title: Issue your first invoice
factura.description: Create a real sales invoice or ask the AI to generate it for you in natural language.
factura.detail: You can create invoices manually from Sales → Invoices → New Invoice, or simply type in the AI chat: 'Invoice [customer] for [concept]' and the agent will create it and ask you for confirmation.

tips.0: Invoices in 'Draft' status do not count in the accounting until you mark them as 'Pending'.
tips.1: Download the PDF directly from the invoice list.

ia.title: Talk to the AI
ia.description: The AI agent is available at all times. Write to it in natural language and it will execute real actions.
ia.detail: Click the AI assistant button (bottom-right corner) or from the AI Tasks panel. You can ask it things like: 'Show me invoices pending payment this month', 'Create a payroll for María García' or 'Give me the February sales summary'.

tips.0: The AI always asks you for confirmation before executing irreversible actions.
tips.1: You can speak in Spanish with accents, abbreviations or informal language.
tips.2: The task history is in the 'AI Tasks' panel.

compras.title: Record your expenses and received invoices
compras.description: Scan or upload supplier invoices. The AI extracts the data and categorizes it automatically.
compras.detail: In Purchases → Invoices you can record supplier invoices manually, or use the Scanner to upload a PDF or photo — the AI will read the tax ID, amount and VAT for you.

tips.0: Recorded expenses automatically feed the P&L in Accounting.
tips.1: Mark invoices as 'Paid' to keep track of your treasury.

automatizaciones.title: Set up an automation
automatizaciones.description: Define rules that the AI runs autonomously: payment reminders, weekly reports, due-date alerts…
automatizaciones.detail: Automations are natural-language instructions that the system runs on a schedule. Example: 'Every Monday at 9am send me a summary of overdue invoices' or 'If an invoice goes more than 30 days unpaid, notify me'.

tips.0: An automation is different from a task: tasks are one-off ('do this for me now'), automations run on their own according to rules.
tips.1: You can pause or delete any automation at any time.
tips.2: Active automations are shown with a green indicator in the panel.

analitica.title: Review your analytics and P&L
analitica.description: With real data already recorded, check the income statement, the chart of accounts and the analytics dashboard.
analitica.detail: The Accounting module calculates Profit & Loss directly from the journal entries (automatically generated by the invoices). Analytics shows trends in income, expenses and your top customers.

tips.0: The P&L updates in real time with every new invoice.
tips.1: The Chart of Accounts follows the Spanish General Accounting Plan (PGC).
